acceptance_criteria: Two sequential campaigns: default then no-embrace; each 45-minute launch window, 2 processes, fresh campaign seed 4.
Read-only section-0/section-5 census on two replays; tree <= 1.25 * baseline plus named pools; zero orphan growth.
Triage every error/crash/softlock/freed/null marker and compare retained presentation against state; fix owned real bugs and replay finding seeds.
Keep combat, saves, RNG, analytics, protected refresh jobs/future-route search and every player-visible design value unchanged.
Retain coverage, findings, before/after proof, Python default-group results, exact owner-only windowed proof commands; no full suites.
inspection_expectation: Worker cannot use window server. Retain headless model checks and write native proof command/contract for design owner; fixture/review/publication remain owner-owned.
working_split: Design owner supplied task/preflight; worker leaves changes uncommitted; no peer-review agents.
observer: Read-only checks before every dispatched decision; first section 0/5 census. Model checks do not prove rendered pixels.
